title: keyboard accelerators not working properly
line: Pressing Alt with a letter no longer triggers icon-only buttons in Plasma popups, such as the system tray's Keep Open pin on Alt+K.
explanation: Plasma Components Button and ToolButton always fed their text to Kirigami's MnemonicData and registered the resulting Alt+letter Shortcut, even when display is IconOnly and the text is never drawn. Every icon-only header button in applet popups (Keep Open, Configure, Back, Add) therefore had an invisible accelerator, which also steals letters from visible buttons. The change disables MnemonicData for buttons whose display is IconOnly, so they get no shortcut and the letter stays free for buttons that show it.

commits.message:
plasmacomponents3: don't give icon-only buttons a mnemonic

Button and ToolButton registered an Alt+letter shortcut from their text
even with display set to IconOnly, so pressing it triggered a button that
shows no underlined letter, like the system tray's Keep Open pin on Alt+K.

BUG: 496737

patches.diff:
From bbce8a629dcf24cf9342e8c1b5f51ea488aeb9d6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:25:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasmacomponents3: don't give icon-only buttons a mnemonic

Button and ToolButton registered an Alt+letter shortcut from their text
even with display set to IconOnly, so pressing it triggered a button that
shows no underlined letter, like the system tray's Keep Open pin on Alt+K.

BUG: 496737
---
 src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/Button.qml     | 2 +-
 src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ToolButton.qml | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/Button.qml b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/Button.qml
index 089f86adc..23e90eaab 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/Button.qml
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/Button.qml
@@ -33,7 +33,7 @@ T.Button {
 
     hoverEnabled: !Kirigami.Settings.tabletMode
 
-    Kirigami.MnemonicData.enabled: control.enabled && control.visible
+    Kirigami.MnemonicData.enabled: control.enabled && control.visible && control.display !== T.AbstractButton.IconOnly
     Kirigami.MnemonicData.controlType: Kirigami.MnemonicData.SecondaryControl
     Kirigami.MnemonicData.label: control.text
 
diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ToolButton.qml b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ToolButton.qml
index cb1357ddf..931c0c91d 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ToolButton.qml
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ToolButton.qml
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ T.ToolButton {
 
     Accessible.onPressAction: clicked()
 
-    Kirigami.MnemonicData.enabled: control.enabled && control.visible
+    Kirigami.MnemonicData.enabled: control.enabled && control.visible && control.display !== T.AbstractButton.IconOnly
     Kirigami.MnemonicData.controlType: Kirigami.MnemonicData.SecondaryControl
     Kirigami.MnemonicData.label: control.text
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: tray popup with Keep Open off (top); after Alt+K the icon-only pin is toggled on (bottom), though no letter is shown anywhere.
With the fix: same popup with Keep Open off (top); Alt+K leaves the pin untouched (bottom).

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in libplasma's PlasmaComponents3 Button and ToolButton that disables Kirigami.MnemonicData when display is T.AbstractButton.IconOnly, preventing invisible Alt+letter accelerators on icon-only popup buttons (like Keep Open and Configure) and avoiding letter collisions with visible buttons. Verified live on the reproducible part of the report (visible text mnemonics remain working) with libplasma autotests passing.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in libplasma's PlasmaComponents3 Button and ToolButton that disables Kirigami.MnemonicData when display is T.AbstractButton.IconOnly, preventing invisible Alt+letter accelerators on icon-only popup buttons (like Keep Open and Configure) and avoiding letter collisions with visible buttons. Verified live on the reproducible part of the report (visible text mnemonics remain working) with libplasma autotests passing.

Disabling Kirigami MnemonicData on PlasmaComponents Button/ToolButton when display is IconOnly is a minimal fix in the right shared place (libplasma). It removes the hidden Alt+letter accelerators on icon-only header buttons such as the Keep Open pin, and frees those letters for buttons that show them. The reporter's other complaint, an underlined letter doing nothing, was recreated on the rig with their Bluetooth popup and already works on master (Alt+C pressed Connect, and Create a New Vault in Vaults), so this closes what is left. The before/after crops clearly show Alt+K toggling the pin before and not after, text-button mnemonics were checked, and the commit message and line match the 2-line diff.
